scientific_integrity: The deterministic asymptotics follow from exact analytic Fourier and Gram identities. Finite numerical checks are supportive only. No independent mathematical validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Sharp asymptotics apply only to a deliberately clustered deterministic three-site subset for the unregularized univariate smoothness-two Korobov kernel of unit weight, with the specified sine-periodization measure; not to typical random subsets, all-site lattices, regularized solvers, other smoothness, or higher dimensions.
title: A two-to-three-node instability transition for periodized Korobov cubature
